title: How does it reach nectar?
hook: A mouthpart can be stored in one shape and used in another.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The second butterfly has a long proboscis extending into the flower. The first shows it coiled near the head. The diagram is schematic and does not represent every butterfly species or food source.

misconception: A butterfly drinks nectar through its antennae.
objective: In this simplified comparison, which mouthpart reaches the liquid inside a flower?
